interpretation: No weighted better score is invented before costs are declared.
A withheld answer is separately reported from a correct answer.
A correct HIGH-consequence raw answer withheld by the hybrid is a measured suppression cost.
An incorrect HIGH-consequence raw answer withheld by the hybrid is measured prevented exposure, not proof of truth detection.
LOW-consequence output differences are measured because v0.35 promises neural-primary passthrough, not content correction.
